purpose: Procedural premium surface/material layer. Load only after visual architecture and premium style are selected.
authority: All colors are semantic roles from the active Design System. Material systems never replace brand identity or factual media.
rules: Use one dominant material language per scene and no more than two supporting material accents.
Material must support hierarchy, evidence or motion; do not add material only to fill empty space.
Prefer neutral or surfaceAlt breathing fields when a Design System primary role would otherwise dominate the frame.
Never use abstract territory, contour, mesh or technical materials as if they were factual maps, engineering drawings or measurements.
Documentary materials organize verified media; they never substitute for verified media.
Cinematic materials may frame conceptual/generative media but cannot turn generated pixels into documentary evidence.
